BJP Aides Removed Amid Allegations of Corruption

The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) has removed four aides from the office of its leader, Bhupender Yadav. The Congress party has accused the BJP of removing the aides due to allegations of corruption related to a financial scheme called 'Chanda Do Dhandha Lo'. The BJP has not commented on the allegations, while the Congress party is demanding an explanation for the removals.
